CustomField.formula: (FLOOR(( Today()- Last_Modified_Date_Status__c)/7)*2) + (IF((MOD( Last_Modified_Date_Status__c- DATE(2000,1,2),7) = 6 && MOD( Today() - DATE(2000,1,2),7) != 6) || (MOD( Last_Modified_Date_Status__c- DATE(2000,1,2),7) != 6 && MOD( Today() - DATE(2000,1,2),7) = 6), 1, IF(MOD(Last_Modified_Date_Status__c- DATE(2000,1,2),7) > MOD( Today() - DATE(2000,1,2),7), 2, 0)))
